summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution for a routine quarterly cash dividend. On October 13, 2026, the board declared KRW 600 per common share, a 1.17% dividend yield, totaling KRW 142,033,277,400 across 236,722,129 eligible shares. The record date is October 28, 2026, with payment expected November 12, 2026; no shareholders meeting is required. All seven outside directors voted in favor. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement, not a special situation, with no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle.
